notMigrated.title: ⏳ This page has not been migrated to the cross-platform frontend yet ({0})
notMigrated.body: The cross-platform frontend (Avalonia) currently covers the main window plus the settings window shell and the General page; the remaining tabs exist only in the WPF build. This is a known gap, not a broken feature.
notMigrated.hintWindows: Workaround: on Windows use the WPF build (the one the installer ships) — it is feature complete.
notMigrated.hintOther: Workaround: edit app/backend/config.json directly for the settings this page would expose, or wait for a later release to migrate it.

inference.title: 🎛️ Inference (sampling)
inference.topPTip: Candidate pool; lower is more focused
inference.repeatTip: Higher curbs repetition, too high sounds stiff
inference.profileTip: The Fast / Balanced / Quality profiles set the initial context, the usable share of the ceiling, the batch size and the thread preference; saving a change rebuilds the model.
inference.profileFastTip: Lower context, larger batch and every logical thread, for a faster first token.
inference.profileBalancedTip: The recommended default, balancing first-token latency against long-context capacity.
inference.profileQualityTip: Full usable context and a larger initial window, with an F16 KV cache, at the highest memory cost.
inference.contextNoModel: No model loaded yet: the native and usable context will appear once a model is ready.
inference.contextNativeUsable: Native context {0} tokens · usable {1} tokens · batch {2}
inference.contextTip: The native context comes from the model file header; the usable value is also bounded by the native window, hardware memory and the configured ceiling.
inference.overrideHint: Defaults to the recommendation; edits are loaded as requested. Over-budget values only warn and never block saving.
inference.hardwareGpuCpu: 🎮 GPU: no usable accelerator detected; using CPU inference ({0})
inference.warnContextOverBudget: ⚠️ n_ctx {0} exceeds the hardware budget of {1} tokens; saving will try your value and report an explicit error if loading fails.
inference.warnGpuUnavailable: ⚠️ No usable GPU accelerator was detected; n_gpu_layers={0} will fail at load time.
inference.warnGpuLayersOver: ⚠️ n_gpu_layers {0} is above the safe recommendation of {1}; VRAM may be insufficient.
inference.testingLoad: ⏳ Testing the current parameters (up to 60 seconds)…
inference.clarifyVagueTip: Ask first when the request is unclear
inference.saveTip: Writes the four sampling parameters, the preset, the context strategy and both switches to config.json
inference.resetTip: Put this parameter back to its default (press Save to apply)
inference.readHint: These values are written to config.json when saved and survive a restart.

ecosystem.title: 🌐 Ecosystem: local API and external models
ecosystem.intro: Open EchoDesk to other tools: let IDE extensions use local inference, or connect an external model service. The local API is off by default and always listens on 127.0.0.1 only.
ecosystem.localApiIntro: Point Cline, Continue, Cursor, curl or Postman at the endpoint below. Both one-shot and streaming responses are supported.
ecosystem.localApiKeyHint: Leave empty for no authentication. The socket only binds 127.0.0.1, so other machines cannot reach it either way.
ecosystem.localApiSecurity: 🔒 The listening address is fixed at 127.0.0.1 and cannot be changed: this API is never reachable from the local network.
ecosystem.providerIntro: The default provider is the local llama.cpp engine. An Ollama daemon or any OpenAI-compatible service can be used instead.
ecosystem.providerKeyHint: Stored in plain text in config.json (this version has no OS keychain integration).
ecosystem.providerStatusIdle: Changes are validated and saved by the backend.
ecosystem.providerConsentLocal: The current endpoint is on this machine, so data does not leave it; no consent is needed.
ecosystem.providerConsentWarning: The endpoint below is NOT on this machine. Enabling it sends your conversations and documents to that external service, and EchoDesk's local-privacy promise does not apply in this mode. You bear the risk of data disclosure.
ecosystem.providerConsentAgain: A confirmation dialog appears on every save of an external endpoint; the save is refused unless you confirm.
ecosystem.providerLocalNoTest: The local engine needs no connection test.
ecosystem.portRange: ⚠️ The port must be between 1024 and 65535.
ecosystem.consentBody: Warning: enabling this feature sends your conversations and documents to that external service. EchoDesk's local-privacy promise does not apply in this mode. You must bear the risk of data disclosure yourself.
ecosystem.consentCheck: I understand and accept the risk of data disclosure
ecosystem.consentRequired: ⚠️ You must tick the acknowledgement before saving.
ecosystem.readUnavailable: ⚠️ Could not read the state (the backend did not answer); press “↻ Reload” to retry.
